conventions.axes: Y-up, right-handed; camera looks down -Z by default; ground is the XZ plane at y = 0
conventions.lightIntensity: three.js physical units (directional/hemisphere/ambient: lux-like; spot/point: candela, decay 2)
conventions.easing: named functions from kit/time.js `ease` (formulas in references/kit-api.md)
conventions.camera: fov is vertical field of view in degrees (three.js convention); sensor-agnostic

style.name: CRT Retro
style.description: A vintage beige computer terminal on a wood desk in a dark room at night: a chunky yellowed-plastic monitor with a deeply curved CRT whose phosphor text types itself (scanlines, barrel curvature, halation, a block cursor), a clacky two-tone keyboard whose keys press with the typing, floppy drives, a desk lamp, a mug and a pinned note; the screen glow spills colour onto the desk and keys.

yellowing.description: uneven sun-yellowing blotches in the beige

motion: Power-on: a bright horizontal line opens to a full raster with a brightness bloom; power-off collapses to a line, then a dot that fades.
Text types at a seeded human cadence (one clack per key, the matching 3D key presses); machine replies print fast after a soft beep.
Freshly drawn characters flash and settle, and the cursor leaves a short trail — both computed from each character's own reveal time.
Screens clear with a top-to-bottom beam wipe; the block cursor is solid while moving and blinks when idle.
Camera: slow push-in from a wide desk shot until the tube fills the frame, an over-the-keys angle for typing, then a pull back out.

objects.procedural: 4.5 x 2.4 m dark painted plaster wall plane at z = -0.42
2.8 x 1.1 m walnut-plank desk top, 45 mm thick, top surface at y = 0
0.5 x 0.34 m framed cork board with two pinned handwritten notes
black articulated desk lamp (weighted base, twin lower arms, spring, open cone shade) with a warm spotlight aimed at the desk right
beige system unit with two 5.25-inch drives, CRT monitor on top (curved tube + CRT shader screen), two-tone keyboard with pressable keys, cable

notes.mechanism: Screen content = planScreen(PROGRAM) evaluated per frame (pure). Key clacks, beeps and power sounds are scoreFromEvents(plan.events, typingVoices()).
